limits: Indian series and TV shows reported with Telugu audio; Telugu originals are excluded, matching the movie catalog scope.
Rolling 365 days of source-listed releases; coverage depends on publishers and verified series identities.
Reported audio applies to listed releases/seasons, not necessarily every episode. Regional availability and actual audio tracks are not inspected.

One entry per IMDb series ID. Order is the latest past episode date within a source-confirmed Telugu season, or the Telugu release date if later. Unspecified seasons use only the listed Telugu release date. Future episodes and unlisted seasons cannot promote a show.

Unmatched titles, unconfirmed seasons, uncertain original languages and conflicting identities remain excluded. An English-original field on a public TMDB page needs publisher or Wikidata corroboration for Indian series; English defaults conflicted with Telugu originals during validation.

91mobiles requires an explicit [Telugu] streaming-offer label; presence on its Telugu category page alone is insufficient. Original-language and India-origin checks remain required. SV Telugu OTT returned HTTP 403 in this browser during validation and contributes no rows.
If all sources fail or no series are verified, the previous series data is preserved.
